reason: A DSH Web chat plugin that optimizes a user’s draft prompt through the configured model and returns the result to the input field for review before sending.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天页面中调用当前模型优化输入框里的提示词，并将结果回填供用户确认和编辑。
summaries.en: Optimizes the prompt draft in the DSH Web chat input using the configured model and fills the result back for review and editing.

capabilities: Reads the current chat prompt draft
Sends the draft to the configured model for optimization
Replaces the draft in the chat input with the generated optimized prompt
Displays status and failure messages in the chat interface
